editions.credit: Homilies on the Epistle to the Ephesians, in A Select Library of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, series I, vol. XIII (Homilies on Galatians, Ephesians, Philippians, Colossians, Thessalonians, Timothy, Titus, and Philemon), trans. The Oxford translation (Library of the Fathers), revised for the American edition; the original Oxford translators are not named on the pages opened; revised with additional notes by Gross Alexander (Buffalo; New York: Christian Literature Co., 1889).
